The '''MPO-1400 ''Purgill''-class star cruiser''',<ref name="Midnight Horizon" /> also known as the '''MPO-1400 Star Cruiser'''<ref name="Display D23">{{Twitter|GermainLussier|status/1164732700143439872|Germain Lussier|archivedate=20200813103412}}</ref> the '''Chandrilan Class I starship''',<ref name="Galaxy's Edge">[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]]</ref> or simply an '''MPO cruiser'''<ref name="Midnight Horizon" /> was a class of [[Star Cruiser]] in service from the [[High Republic Era]] to the [[New Republic Era]], manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="WDWNT" /> One [[Star]] [[Cruiser]] was the ''[[Halcyon]]'', which was operated by [[Chandrila Star Line]]. It was roughly twice as large as a [[CR90 corvette]],<ref name="D23" /> and it had thirteen [[engine]]s that were arranged in the unique [[Drabor Configuration]].<ref name="SW.com D23" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The MPO-1400 Purrgil-class star cruiser ''Halcyon'' was the setting for ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|Star Wars Galactic Starcruiser]],'' a luxury roleplaying experience formerly located in [[Wikipedia:Florida|Florida]].<ref name="D23" /> Although the ship is named after the [[purrgil]], a [[species]] of spacefaring creatures,<ref name="SOTG">{{SW|url=news/ships-of-the-galaxy-the-halcyon-starcruiser|text=Ships of the Galaxy: The ''Halcyon'' Starcruiser|int=Ships of the Galaxy}}</ref> the name was misspelled in the novel ''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]''.<ref name="Midnight Horizon" />
